description: Saves a new firing log in your Glazecalc account (the Firing page): its title, the day, the kiln, the columns kept (time, temperature, cone, atmosphere, comments...) and a row for each reading, as the person dictated them. Add later readings with add_firing_rows. Save only what the person said and agreed to; never fill in an amount, temperature or analysis they did not give. Needs an access token that can read and change your records.

columns.description: The columns kept, by these names, as on the Firing page: Time, Temperature F or Temperature C (the scale said), Cone, Atmosphere, Ramp, Hold, Damper, Comments and the rest.

date.description: The day it was fired, as 2026-10-21; today when left out.

kiln.description: The kiln, as the person names it.

notes.description: Anything else said about the firing, in the person’s words.

rows.description: One row for each reading, one cell for each column, in column order, as the person said it ("9:40", "1850", "5 bending"); "" for a cell not said.

title.description: The log’s name, as the person gave it ("Glaze firing, cone 6").

name: create_firing_log
title: Save a new firing log
